blocks.text: Janwar ki jins (sex, yaani nar ya maada hona) us ki janeeni nashonuma (embryonic development) ke dauran tay hoti hai. Zyada tar janwaron mein jins karyotype ki bunyad par tay hoti hai. Karyotype cells mein chromosomes ke poore set ki shakal o surat hai: chromosomes ki tadaad, size aur banawat. Zyada tar janwaron ke karyotype mein aik jore ke siwa baqi sab chromosome jore nar aur maada mein aik jaise hote hain. Jo chromosomes nar aur maada mein bilkul aik jaise hain unhein autosomes kehte hain. Aik jora nar aur maada mein mukhtalif hota hai aur yahi jins tay karta hai; is jore ke chromosomes ko sex chromosomes kehte hain. Karyotype ki bunyad par jins tay hone ke bare nizam (systems) agle lesson mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Insan ke jismani (body) cell mein kitne autosomes hote hain?
blocks.explanation: 44, yaani 22 jore, aur sex chromosomes ka aik jora; kul 46.

items: Karyotype: cell ke chromosomes ki tadaad, size aur shakal.
Autosomes nar aur maada mein aik jaise; sex chromosomes ka aik jora mukhtalif aur jins tay karta hai.
